suitability.intro: Update your answers if your situation changed. Your adviser reviews the answers.

custody.a: Interactive Brokers, in an account in your name. Interactive Brokers is the broker and custodian; OpenDollars is your investment adviser.

cost.a: Before you confirm each deposit you see every cost, line by line, and how much arrives to invest. The details are in the terms.

minimum.q: Why is there a monthly minimum?
minimum.a: The monthly plan minimum is {{min}}. With less, fixed transfer costs take too large a share of what you invest.

window.q: Why does investing happen once a month?
window.a: The portfolio is invested in a monthly window, around day {{day}}. Money that has already arrived may sit as cash in your Interactive Brokers account until then.

opening.q: How long does opening the account take?
opening.a: A few business days. Interactive Brokers reviews your information and, if it needs anything else, we ask you under Pending.

wrongNetwork.q: What do I do if I sent on the wrong network?
wrongNetwork.a: Write to support right away with the transfer details. A wrong network can mean losing the funds: we can't assure you they will be recovered, but we will review your case.

withdraw.q: How do I take my money out?
withdraw.a: From your Interactive Brokers account, through the link in Profile. A withdrawal can only go to a bank account in your name.
